evidence: Visitors seen swimming in the sea and playing on the sand at Pantai Lagoon, Ancol (Pademangan, Jakarta Utara); caveat: periodic swimming bans (2015 dead fish, 2021 COVID), artificial sand shore - https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5310900/akhir-pekan-usai-libur-natal-kawasan-ancol-ramai-pengunjung

White sand beach 10-15 min from Jayapura city; relatively gentle waves make it suitable for swimming and snorkeling (caveat: rocks in the water) - https://rri.co.id/en/tourism/2719008/base-g-beach-a-tropical-escape-in-papuas-jayapura-with-a-world-war-ii-history

White-sand beach in Dalegan, Panceng with shallow water and marked swimming zone; police told visitors to stay inside the swimming zone (Lebaran 2026) - https://jurnalmahasiswa.stiesia.ac.id/index.php/jirm/article/download/6407/6461/ ; https://beritajatim.com/?p=1488986

Santolo (Cikelet) white soft sand beach described as usable for swimming; caveat: south-coast waves, Rancabuaya swimming discouraged - https://www.goodnewsfromindonesia.id/2023/05/26/wisata-alam-di-garut

Jayanti (Cidaun) wide white-sand beach where visitors play in the water and swim; caveat: strong south-coast waves, drownings reported 2025 - https://auto2000.co.id/berita-dan-tips/pantai-di-jawa-barat-tips
Pulau Merah (Pesanggaran) reddish-sand beach; calm waves described as perfect for swimming, surf further out - https://www.idxchannel.com/ecotainment/5-rekomendasi-pantai-di-banyuwangi

Pantai Gope (Karangantu, Kasemen) is not a sand beach like Anyer and cannot be used for playing in water or swimming; pier/port/mangrove coast - https://mojok.co/terminal/pantai-gopek-mutiara-yang-tersembunyi-di-banten/

Popular swimming beach; police reminded parents to watch swimming children and stay within red-flag/buoy zones - https://tribratanews.kaltim.polri.go.id/2023/12/dalam-rangka-libur-natal-dan-tahun-baru-dit-polairud-polda-kaltim-melaksanakan-pengamanan

Pantai Santai (Desa Latulahat, Nusaniwe, Kota Ambon) white sand, clear water, gently sloping shore suited to swimming, snorkeling, diving - https://wartaekonomi.co.id/read234025/jelajah-ambon-kunjungi-3-tempat-wisata-romantis-ini

Pasir Panjang beach in Desa Wates, Lekok is visited for recreation and swimming (suitability index 84%); caveat: water rated moderately polluted (STORET) - https://journal.trunojoyo.ac.id/jurnalkelautan/article/view/8378

Pink/white coral sand beach in Sekaroh, Jerowaru; calm clear water described as safe to play/swim in with children; no lifeguards - https://www.trac.astra.co.id/en/blog/en-travel/lombok-s-pink-beach-a-hidden-gem-in-the-island-of-a-thousand-mosques/1153

Pondok Bali (Mayangan, Legonkulon) sand beach where visitors play in sand, swim and fish - https://www.detik.com/jabar/wisata/d-6059547/5-tempat-wisata-terbaik-di-subang-sejuk-pegunungan-pantai-eksotis

Listed among Karawang beaches: fine white sand and clear water suitable for snorkeling or swimming; caveat: Pantai Sedari had oil-spill swimming ban, Tanjung Pakis swim evidence not found - https://www.telkomsel.com/jelajah/jelajah-lifestyle/7-tempat-wisata-karawang-yang-lagi-hits

Tirta Ayu (Balongan) soft sand and small waves, comfortable for children and adults to swim; Tirtamaya (Juntinyuat) also cited for swimming - https://www.detik.com/jabar/foto/d-6477472/nuansa-bali-di-pantai-tirta-ayu-indramayu
Gently sloping sand beach where visitors swim with limits due to big waves; Balawista on duty; Karanghawu has rip currents - https://www.orami.co.id/magazine/pantai-pelabuhan-ratu

Lower part of Jumiang is soft white sand; visitors (school children) photographed playing and swimming there; caveat: police advise no swimming in strong currents - https://jatim.antaranews.com/foto/346953/menikmati-libur-imlek

Long white-sand gently sloping beach in Kota Bengkulu; visitors swim, but rip currents cause drownings and BPBD issues seasonal no-swimming advisories/warning signs in some areas - https://www.goodnewsfromindonesia.id/2024/12/20/daftar-pantai-di-bengkulu-lengkap-dengan-alamat-htm-dan-daya-tarik

Cipatujah (iron/white sand) has big waves and visitors are not allowed/advised to swim; nearby Padabumi also no swimming and Karang Tawulan is coral - https://kumparan.com/seputar-jabar/5-tempat-wisata-di-tasikmalaya-ada-pantai-hingga-air-terjun-24a8JZemO67
Lombang (Batang-Batang) 12 km white sand with cemara udang; gentle waves suitable for swimming - https://www.popmama.com/life/health/pantai-di-madura-dengan-ombak-tenang-00-f62c5-1j61r9
Anyer (Kabupaten Serang) white-sand beach with clear water suitable for swimming; Sambolo and Marbella also calm for swimming - https://auto2000.co.id/berita-dan-tips/pantai-anyer-tips
